F1: Equal top priorities make automatic selection nondeterministic and can select a non-FIPS provider in FIPS deployments.
F2: Malformed DER can trigger unchecked exceptions or be accepted incorrectly despite the decoder’s IOException contract.
F3: Returning the default keystore provider violates the provider contract and can misidentify the crypto provider when this implementation is selected.
F4: Adding an abstract SPI method breaks source and binary compatibility for external implementations.
F5: Missing test coverage is not itself a defect in the changed code.
